definitions.explanation: The small, triangular bone at the bottom of the spine, the vestigial remnant of the human tail. Used in medical contexts and when describing injuries from falling on the lower back.

examples.japanese: {尾骨|びこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧{尾骨|びこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I fell and fractured my tailbone.

examples.japanese: {尾骨|びこつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}いた→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{整形外科|せいけいげか}→整形外科：22066_seikeigeka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{診|み}て→診る：09798_miru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The pain in my tailbone wouldn't go away, so I had it examined at an orthopedic clinic.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{尾|び}→尾：18068_bi⟧ (tail) and {骨|こつ} (bone). A medical/anatomical term. In everyday conversation, Japanese speakers are at least as likely to use the more colloquial {尻尾|しっぽ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ or simply ⟦お{尻|しり}→お尻：05856_oshiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧ when describing a fall.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {尾骨|びこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to bruise/hit one's tailbone
- {尾骨|びこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fracture one's tailbone
- {尾骨|びこつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: one's tailbone hurts
- {尾骨|びこつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧: pain in the tailbone
